svg.title: Accounting exports beyond CSV — SoftTrack web design mockup (#301)
svg.desc: A payroll run and a reimbursement batch each export a CSV in SoftTrack’s own layout, and somebody rearranges the columns for the accounting system every month. Finance maps categories, pay item types and departments to account codes; a journal export is balanced lines; a payment file is for the bank; and every export is recorded.

g.text: Finance → Exports, signed in as Omar
What leaves SoftTrack for the accounting system and the bank. A file, sent nowhere.

svg.text: A payment file for the bank

g.text: Entered by the person, read by them and by finance. Stored
encrypted, and masked wherever they are shown.
An export is of frozen rows and can be produced again, identically.

svg.text: Done when finance can map each expense category, pay item type and department to account codes that SoftTrack stores and does not interpret; a paid run, a paid batch and an
approved invoice export as a journal of balanced lines; layouts include a generic CSV and the import layouts of common packages, one file each; a SEPA credit transfer file can be
produced from bank details that are stored encrypted and masked; and every export is recorded.
